## Key Projects
- [Classroom Compass (Main)](https://github.com/Classroom-Compass) - AI Attention Detection System. Uses a YOLOv8x segmentation-based pipeline to isolate head-torso regions of students, with a TensorFlow CNN model to classify focused vs. distracted states, served via a FastAPI backend.
  - [Person Segregation Model](https://github.com/asifur8282/Classroom-Person-Segregation-Model)
  - [Classifier Model](https://github.com/asifur8282/Classroom-Compass-Classifier)
- [Vision-Guided GazeBot](https://github.com/asifur8282/ML-Vision-Guided-GazeBot) - Camera-based control interface where an ESP32-driven robotic vehicle aligns its direction with the user's head position tracked via MediaPipe and OpenCV.
- [Heart Disease Prediction Model](https://github.com/asifur8282/Heart-Disease-Prediction) - SVM model predicting heart disease risk based on patient attributes with 90% accuracy, trained on a Kaggle dataset.
- [CSV to WhatsApp Messages](https://github.com/asifur8282/CSV-to-Whatsapp-Messages) - Automated workflow using Python (Selenium) to read CSV files and send formatted WhatsApp messages for event management.
- **PID-Based Self-Balancing Bot** - A two-wheeled robot using PID control loops and sensor feedback for dynamic stability.
- **Earthquake Survivor Detection** - YOLO model tuning for post-disaster search-and-rescue.
- **Iris Flower Prediction** - Decision Tree Classifier using scikit-learn.
